title: Senior, Human Resource Systems Analyst
jobDescription:
We are seeking a skilled Workday Analyst with strong functional expertise to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for configuring, managing, and optimizing Workday business processes to ensure smooth HR and Finance operations. This role requires a deep expertise in Workday modules, strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and the ability to translate business requirements into effective system configurations. The individual will collaborate closely with the Workday HR team to implement new features and continuously enhance system functionality. What You’ll Do: Configure and maintain Workday business processes, including HR, Payroll, Benefits, and Compensation modules. Experience developing Workday custom reports and calculated fields Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document functional requirements. Strong understanding of Workday security configuration, policies, and best practices. Experience with security auditing, monitoring, and incident response Design, test, and implement efficient Workday solutions aligned with organizational policies and industry best practices. Coordinate with the Workday team on security roles and access permissions in accordance with compliance standards. Troubleshoot and resolve system issues related to business processes and integrations. Coordinate with technical teams to support integrations, reports, and system upgrades. Provide training and support to end-users on Workday functionality and business process changes. Participate in Workday release updates and ensure timely adoption of new features. Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation for business process configurations and workflows. 8+ years of Workday experience with at least one full implementation You should have: Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Information Technology, Business Administration, or related field. Proven experience as a Workday Analyst or Functional Consultant, ideally 3+ years. Strong knowledge of Workday business processes, configuration, and security. Hands-on experience in configuring Workday modules such as HCM, Payroll, Time Tracking, Benefits, or Compensation. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to communicate complex technical information clearly to non-technical stakeholders. Experience working in cross-functional teams and managing multiple priorities. A Big Plus: Detail-oriented with a strong focus on accuracy and process efficiency. Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work collaboratively. Proactive approach to identifying improvements and resolving issues. Familiarity with Workday reporting and integration tools is a plus. title: People Operations Generalist
jobDescription:
Alation is looking for a People Operations Generalist to join our global People team and serve as a key HR partner for our Alationauts across the company This is a high-impact, fast-paced role sitting at the intersection of HR operations, employee experience, and systems excellence. You'll keep the engine running — owning core HR processes, ensuring our data is accurate and our people feel supported — while partnering closely with our HRBPs and cross-functional teams to scale our programs globally. If you're someone who thrives in ambiguity, loves solving problems, and finds meaning in delivering a genuinely great employee experience, this role is for you. What You'll Do People Operations Own day-to-day HR operations including onboarding/offboarding, benefits administration for India, support payroll inquiries, immigration coordination, and intranet maintenance. Serve as a trusted first point of contact for employee inquiries — responding promptly, troubleshooting effectively, and escalating when needed through the companies ticketing system (e.g., JIRA, Serval) Partner with Talent Acquisition, IT, Payroll, and HRBPs to deliver a seamless, "red carpet" experience at every touchpoint of the employee lifecycle. Respond to employment verification requests and manage related documentation with accuracy and timeliness. Conduct periodic compliance and benefits audits; identify gaps and recommend process improvements. Maintain high standards of data integrity across HR systems — ensuring records are accurate, up-to-date, and audit-ready. Pull reports, process data changes, and prepare workforce analytics for managers and business partners. Contribute to special projects and initiatives that support People team priorities. What You Bring Experience & Skills 5+ years of experience in HR operations or a generalist HR role. Hands-on experience with Workday (strongly preferred) — including HCM, reporting, and data management; understanding of how HR modules integrate across a broader system ecosystem. Strong working knowledge of Google Suite (Docs, Sheets, Slides, Forms). Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to tailor your message to different audiences. Proven ability to handle sensitive, confidential information with discretion and professionalism. Sharp organizational skills and strong attention to detail, even when juggling competing priorities. Comfort with ambiguity — you can pivot quickly without losing your footing. Competencies Integrity — You handle sensitive information with care. Confidentiality isn't a checkbox for you; it's a core value. Collaboration — You build genuine relationships across all levels of the organization and know how to get things done through partnership, not just process. Initiative — You don't wait to be told what needs fixing. You spot it, own it, and follow through. Adaptability — Priorities shift and you roll with it. You're comfortable re-prioritizing on the fly and maintaining a positive, can-do attitude. Communication — You know what to say and, more importantly, how to say it. You're a good listener and genuinely open to other perspectives. Analytical Thinking — You can turn raw data into meaningful insight, supporting sound decisions for managers and the broader People team. Technical Savvy — You can troubleshoot functional and technical issues in HR systems, with Workday experience at the top of your toolkit. Service Mindset — You care about the people you support. Every interaction is an opportunity to build trust and deliver a great experience. #LI-AS1 Alation, Inc. is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. jobDescription:
Alation is looking to add a Senior Human Resources Business Partner to our growing People team in Chennai reporting to the Director, Human Resources (HR). The ideal candidate is strategic and scrappy, with the ability to embody and scale our culture as we grow. This role partners with and supports a variety of teams across the region, with the largest groups being R&D and Customer Solutions. title: Senior Software Engineer
jobDescription:
Are you ready to be a force multiplier in an AI-first engineering culture? As an SE4 at Alation, you won’t just own components—you’ll define the technical bar and shape the future of our data connector ecosystem. This is a high-autonomy, high-impact role where you’ll tackle the most ambitious technical challenges, influence broad architectural decisions, and empower everyone around you to excel. We’re looking for a visionary technical leader who thrives on ambiguity and is passionate about scaling business-critical systems for the world’s largest enterprise customers. Your Impact & Challenges Architect and Lead: Drive the design of complex, multi-service features from concept through delivery, ensuring they are robust, scalable, and secure. Elevate Standards: Set the gold standard for code quality, testing discipline, and performance benchmarks that the entire team will follow. Navigate Ambiguity: Decompose large-scale initiatives into actionable engineering milestones, keeping the team unblocked and moving with velocity. Cultivate Talent: Act as a dedicated mentor, growing the next generation of engineers through thoughtful code reviews and technical partnership. Solve the Unsolvable: Be the point of escalation for our most complex customer issues, driving root cause analysis and permanent resolutions. Innovate with AI: Master and champion AI-native engineering tools like Claude Code and Git Hub Copilot to accelerate shipping while maintaining elite quality. Govern AI Integration: Establish the patterns for prompting and review that balance rapid velocity with production-grade reliability. Shape the Team: Calibrate our hiring bar and help us identify the talent needed to scale our mission. Broaden Influence: Serve as a credible, strategic voice in architectural discussions across the entire organization. What You Bring Over 8 years of professional experience crafting and shipping production software or n-tier services at scale. Exceptional skills in object-oriented design, with deep expertise in Java (our primary stack) and/or Python & Go. A proven track record of delivering end-to-end systems, including cross-service integrations and extensibility frameworks. A talent for technical writing and architectural leadership, with the ability to win peer buy-in for your designs. A productivity-first mindset using AI coding assistants (Cursor, Copilot, etc.) to enhance your workflow without sacrificing critical judgment. Experience modeling AI-augmented habits for your peers, sharing techniques that help the whole team level up. Expertise in microservices and distributed systems that are built for resilience. Strong communicative clarity, capable of translating deep technical complexity for anyone from a peer to a non-technical stakeholder. Passion for technical leadership and a history of successfully mentoring other engineers. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field. title: Software Engineer II
jobDescription:
We’re looking for an Engineer who’s eager to make a real impact in the world of AI and help multiple teams at Alation use AI to realize higher productivity and efficiency. You’ll be part of a small team that will design and build AI agentic applications powered by Alation’s data, in short iterations and make them available to multiple departments within the company. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys full-stack coding, working with LLMs from Open AI and Anthropic, and learning how to turn ideas into real-world systems. This position offers immense ownership and significant business influence, focused on delivering a future vision that provides genuine value for our users. What You’ll Do Understand and work with internal data warehouses as well as other business applications such as Salesforce. Develop and monitor robust data pipelines for agent workflows, owning data validation, quality checks, and pipeline reliability. Work with a Product Manager and Engineering Manager to design and iterate agentic solutions quickly. Build purposeful AI Agents: Work with modern LLM and agent frameworks (e.g., Lang Chain, Pydantic-AI) — evaluate, benchmark, and refine performance. Build AI-powered applications: Develop agentic systems that combine structured data, language models, and workflow to solve real-world problems. Code with care: Write clean, well-structured Python and Type Script code for integrations, pipelines, and intelligent systems. title: Sr. Content Operations Manager, GEO & AI Visibility
jobDescription:
Alation delivers an agentic knowledge layer that enables enterprises to achieve business outcomes and grow their most critical asset, knowledge. Alation pioneered the data catalog market and is trusted by hundreds of Fortune 5000 companies. Alation empowers organizations to realize hard ROI and business outcomes from data and AI. We’re looking for a technically fluent content operator to join our marketing team and help us modernize the way we reach enterprise buyers — in search engines, in AI-generated answers, and in the data community. This is a hands-on role leading generative engine optimization (GEO), SEO, agentic content workflows, and editorial production. You’ll work directly with Alation’s Head of Content to execute a program designed to shift how AI models describe us, how prospects find us in a world where LLMs are the new top of funnel, and how search engines rank us. If you are energized by building AI-assisted content systems, obsess over prompt share of voice and citation rates, and can move fast without sacrificing quality, this role is for you. What You’ll Do Own and execute Alation’s LLM visibility and GEO strategy — track prompt share of voice, citation rates, and sentiment using tools like Scrunch, and translate findings into a concrete, executable content plan. Build and run AI-assisted content workflows in Git Hub, connecting intelligence inputs (customer-call transcripts, competitive signals, analyst reports) to scalable publishing outputs — at 10x the speed of traditional production. Write and optimize citable, entity-rich content targeting the “prompt universe” where enterprise buyers ask LLMs about products that support data governance, AI readiness, and agentic data management Lead and manage day-to-day of Alation’s GEO plan building briefs and crafting content, and be accountable for measurable outcomes tied to organic and AI search visibility. Execute content cleanup, redirect strategies, and competitive comparison pages designed to shift how retrieval-augmented LLMs surface and frame Alation vs. category alternatives. Manage off-page authority building, tracking third-party mentions on sites like Reddit and Quora, and delivering content that addresses key competitive gaps Define and report on key metrics — track the Content-to-Pipeline loop across brand mentions, LLM referral trends, page-level engagement, and content reuse across field and digital channels. What You’ll Bring 5+ years of experience in content marketing, digital marketing, or technical content strategy — ideally in B2B Saa S or enterprise software. Demonstrated experience with generative engine optimization (GEO) and LLM visibility — you understand how AI models retrieve, rank, and recommend content, and you’ve built programs to influence that. Ability to write across a variety of channels and platforms, from web copy to white papers and Linked In thought leadership content Deep, hands-on SEO expertise: keyword research, on-page optimization, content gap analysis, and a track record of moving organic rankings. Comfort working in Git Hub to design, document, and iterate on AI-assisted content workflows — you don’t need to write production code, but you think in systems and can build repeatable pipelines with LLM tools. Ability to brief internal and external teams, uphold SLAs, and translate business objectives into actionable content briefs. Strong editorial judgment — you can review LLM-assisted output for technical accuracy, brand voice, and AEO structure (answer capsules, FAQ schema, definition leads) without rewriting from scratch. Familiarity with data and AI concepts — you don’t need to be an engineer, but you should understand what a data catalog and knowledge layer does and why “agentic governance” is a meaningful differentiator. A bias toward fast, measurable progress. You ship, learn, and iterate — you don’t wait for the perfect brief. Experience with LLM visibility platforms such as Profound, Scrunch, SE Ranking AI Visibility, or Otterly.ai. Familiarity with SEMrush, Ahrefs, or equivalent SEO tooling for competitive benchmarking. Nice to Have Background in or exposure to data governance, data cataloging, or the modern data stack. Experience with ABM content strategy — particularly adapting content for vertical-specific plays (Finance, Healthcare, Supply Chain). #LI-SR1 #LI-Hybrid Alation, Inc. is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. jobDescription:

title: Sr. GTM AI Analyst
jobDescription:
Alation is pioneering the next era of data intelligence — powered by AI agents and trusted data. Organizations around the world rely on Alation to drive self-service analytics, cloud transformation, data governance, and AI innovation. Our technology helps enterprises connect people and data to make faster, smarter, and more confident decisions. With more than $340M in funding – valued at over $1.7 billion and more than 650 customers, including 40% of the Fortune
100. As data becomes the foundation of every business, Alation is leading the way in helping organizations unlock their full potential. By bringing intelligence, automation, and trust to every interaction, we empower customers to scale data-driven innovation with confidence and speed. Joining Alation means being part of a winning team shaping the future of AI-powered data intelligence. We move fast, think big, and deliver results together. Job Description We are looking for a Sr. GTM AI Analyst to build, automate, and scale the systems that power Alation's revenue engine. This is not a traditional ops or analyst role — you will write code, architect automation workflows, ship AI-powered systems, and deploy intelligent agents to create pipeline and accelerate revenue. Think of this as a GTM Engineer meets AI Strategist — someone who can analyze what's broken, design the fix, and build it themselves. Reporting to the Director of GTM Operations, you'll sit at the intersection of software engineering, operations, and go-to-market strategy. While Rev Ops keeps our systems running and our teams aligned, you'll be the builder who makes those systems smarter, faster, and more autonomous. You think in workflows, APIs, and logic — not in spreadsheets and slide decks. If you see a manual process, your instinct is to engineer it away. If you see a signal, your instinct is to act on it — automatically. This role requires someone who understands how software is built — not just how tools are configured. You should be as comfortable reading a codebase, writing a Python script, or debugging an API integration as you are mapping a lead-to-opportunity workflow. You'll design and deploy AI-first GTM orchestrations using platforms like Gumloop, n8n, Clay, Make, and Zapier — connecting them to our core stack and extending them with custom code where the platforms fall short. We're looking for someone who is genuinely motivated by Alation's mission to help the world find, understand, and trust data — and who sees AI not as a buzzword but as the fastest path to better outcomes. Note: This is a hybrid role based out of our Chennai office. Local candidates only. What You'll Do Build AI-powered GTM workflows — design and deploy automated systems for lead enrichment, signal-based outreach, lead scoring, and campaign orchestration using tools like Clay, Gumloop, n8n, Make, Zapier, AI agents, and custom APIs. Architect and manage GTM orchestration pipelines — own the design, deployment, and monitoring of multi-step automation workflows across orchestration platforms. Evaluate, select, and combine tools (Gumloop for AI agent workflows, n8n for complex branching logic, Clay for enrichment, Make/Zapier for system glue) based on what each problem demands — not vendor loyalty. Engineer the GTM stack — connect and extend Salesforce, Marketo, Outreach, 6sense, and enrichment tools through custom integrations, APIs, webhooks, and automation platforms to eliminate manual handoffs and data gaps. Write custom code (Python, Java Script, or similar) when out-of-the-box connectors aren't enough. Run rapid experiments — prototype, test, and iterate on new GTM motions (AI-generated sequences, intent-based triggers, dynamic segmentation, agent-driven outreach) with a bias toward speed and measurable impact. Treat every workflow as a hypothesis to be validated. Automate pipeline operations — build systems that monitor buying signals, trigger plays, enrich records, and route leads in real time — reducing time-to-action from days to minutes. Power analytics with clean data — ensure enrichment, deduplication, and hygiene workflows feed accurate, timely data into dashboards and attribution models. Collaborate across the revenue org — partner with Marketing, Sales, Enablement, and Rev Ops to identify high-leverage automation opportunities and ship solutions that the team can scale. Document and hand off — build with the team in mind. Write clear documentation so that what you prototype can be adopted, maintained, and improved by the broader ops team. What You Bring 3–5 years of experience in revenue operations, growth engineering, marketing operations, software engineering, or a technical GTM function in a B2B Saa S environment. Software engineering foundation — you understand how code works at a fundamental level. You've written production-quality scripts, worked with version control (Git), understand data structures, and can debug a broken API call without waiting for help. Formal CS/engineering education or equivalent hands-on experience required. Technical proficiency — SQL is required. Python or Java Script proficiency is required. Experience with REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth, JSON/XML parsing, and scripting for data manipulation is expected. You're comfortable reading docs, working in a terminal, and building integrations from scratch — not just dragging and dropping. Mandatory experience with GTM orchestration platforms — hands-on, demonstrated experience building workflows in at least two of: Clay, Gumloop, n8n, Make, or Zapier. You should understand the strengths and limitations of each, know when to use a no-code platform vs. custom code, and have opinions on which tool is best for what job. Hands-on expertise with GTM tools — deep working knowledge of Salesforce and Marketo, with practical experience in at least two of: Outreach, 6sense, Zoom Info, Apollo, or similar platforms. AI-native mindset — you already use AI tools (Claude, Chat GPT, Copilot) daily in your work and are always looking for the next workflow to automate. You've built AI agent workflows, experimented with prompt chaining, and understand how to orchestrate LLMs within GTM systems. This isn't aspirational for you — it's how you operate. Builder mentality — you'd rather ship an 80% solution today and iterate than spec a perfect one for next quarter. You move with urgency and own the outcome. Analytical rigor — you understand funnel mechanics, attribution, and pipeline math. You don't just build automations — you measure whether they work. Strong communication skills — you can explain what you built, why it matters, and how it performs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders across time zones. What Sets You Apart Experience building end-to-end AI agent workflows in Gumloop or n8n — including multi-step chains with branching logic, API calls, and LLM nodes. Experience building automated enrichment and outreach workflows in Clay — including waterfall enrichment, AI-generated personalization, and CRM write-back. A background in software development or engineering with a deliberate pivot into GTM/Rev Ops — you chose this lane, not defaulted into it. Familiarity with data warehousing concepts (Snowflake, dbt) and how GTM data flows into BI and reporting layers. Experience with infrastructure-as-code or workflow-as-code approaches to managing automation pipelines. Exposure to consumption-based or usage-based business models. A portfolio or examples of GTM systems you've built — we'd love to see what you've shipped. How We Work Alation's values shape everything we do, and we look for people who embody them: Raise the Bar — you hold yourself and your work to a high standard, and you push the team to do the same. Move with Urgency — you bias toward action, ship fast, and learn faster. Win Through Results — you measure success by outcomes, not effort or activity. Build Exceptional Teams — you make the people around you better through collaboration, knowledge-sharing, and respectful partnership. Act Like the Owner You Are — you don't wait to be told. You see what needs to happen and you make it happen. We're looking for someone with a track record of success, a team-first mindset, and the drive to do the best work of their career at a company where data intelligence is becoming the foundation of enterprise AI. ##LI-AS1 Alation, Inc. is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. title: Senior Business Systems Analyst
jobDescription:
Alation is seeking an ambitious Senior Business Systems Analyst with deep expertise in Net Suite administration and strong analytical/technical skills. Reporting directly to the Corporate Controller, this role is critical to supporting and scaling the company’s financial systems, especially Net Suite, across a global software organization. The ideal candidate is a critical thinker who understands ERP systems, accounting principles, and software industry practices. This role requires strong communication skills and the ability to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions that support Alation’s operational and financial growth. What You’ll Be Doing Net Suite Administration & Optimization • Serve as the primary Net Suite administrator. • Configure Net Suite to meet evolving business requirements across GL, AP, AR, Revenue, Billing, Procurement, Payroll, and Financial Reporting. • Build, test, and deploy system customizations including Suite Flow, Suite Builder, saved searches, workflows, dashboards, KPIs, and custom objects. • Maintain oversight of change management, release cycles, role-based access, and audit readiness. • Identify and drive automation, scalability, and process-improvement opportunities within Net Suite. Financial Systems Integrations • Administer, build, and maintain third-party integrations to Net Suite (e.g., billing systems, procurement tools, payroll, data warehouse). • Work with integration platforms such as Workato (maintenance and development experience preferred). • Support end-to-end processes across Order-to-Cash (O2C), Procure-to-Pay (P2P), and Record-to-Report (R2R) cycles. Operational & Cross-Functional Support Act as the primary internal support contact for the Accounting and Finance teams. Troubleshoot issues, manage escalations, and document system configurations and process flows. Translate business requirements into technical designs and coordinate testing and deployment. Collaborate with cross-functional leaders to improve financial systems, reporting, and data quality. What You Need Required • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, or related field. • 5+ years of Accounting/Finance or Financial Systems experience. • 5+ years of hands-on Net Suite administration experience. • Strong proficiency with Suite Flow and Suite Builder. • Experience with financial data structures, accounting processes, and ERP best practices. • Experience supporting or developing system integrations; Workato experience strongly preferred. • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Preferred • Workato maintenance and/or development proficiency. • Has experience being a single point of contact for Net Suite administration and independently project managing larger integration projects. • Experience building or maintaining custom scripts or development within Net Suite. • Software industry experience, especially in Saa S environments. • Experience with ASC 606 and Net Suite ARM. • Net Suite Administrator or Suite Foundation certification.
